使用说明：本资料为电子版，可直接在浏览器打印（Ctrl/Cmd + P）为 PDF 或纸质版；双面打印亦可。例句与解析均为自研仿真写作，用于语境记忆训练。

正文 · 核心词释义与仿真语境

access/ˈækses/required
核心义：通道；进入
访问、进入（系统或数据库）陷阱义
Only registered users can access the database after the system is upgraded.
系统升级后，只有注册用户才能访问该数据库。
搭配 · access the Internet / access data / access a file / be accessed by
使用、获取（资源与设施）陷阱义
Students should be able to access the books and equipment they need in the school library.
学生应当能够使用他们在学校图书馆需要的书籍和设备。
搭配 · access resources / access facilities / access services / be easily accessed
接近…的机会；使用…的权利陷阱义
Children living in remote areas should all have access to quality medical care.
居住在偏远地区的儿童都应当有机会获得优质的医疗服务。
搭配 · have access to / get access to / give sb access to / equal access to
account/əˈkaʊnt/required
核心义：账户
（account for）占（比例）、构成陷阱义
Online sales now account for a growing share of the company's revenue.
线上销售如今占该公司营收的比重不断上升。
搭配 · account for 40% / account for a third of / account for the largest share / which accounts for
（account for）解释、说明原因陷阱义
The storm is thought to account for most of the damage to the old bridge.
人们认为风暴是旧桥大部分损毁的原因。
搭配 · account for the delay / account for the difference / this accounts for / how do you account for
记述、描述（an account of）陷阱义
The book gives a vivid account of the writer's years as a volunteer.
这本书生动地记述了作者当志愿者的那些年。
搭配 · a detailed account of / give an account of / an eyewitness account / a full account of
address/əˈdres/required
核心义：地址；演讲
处理、解决（问题、差距、隐患）陷阱义
The new policy was introduced to address the widening gap between rich and poor.
新政策的出台是为了应对贫富之间日益扩大的差距。
搭配 · address a problem / address the issue / address a concern / address the challenge
称呼、称谓（叫作某称呼）陷阱义
How do you address a colleague from another country you have just met?
你该怎么称呼一位刚认识的外国同事？
搭配 · address sb as / the form of address / address sb by name
演讲、致辞（发表的演说）陷阱义
He delivered a moving address to the graduates at the end of the ceremony.
典礼结束时，他向毕业生们发表了一场动人的致辞。
搭配 · deliver an address / give an address / a closing address / the opening address
affect/əˈfekt/required
核心义：影响
对…产生影响；感染
Bad weather may affect the result of the race.
坏天气可能影响比赛结果。
搭配 · affect the result / be affected by
appeal/əˈpi:l/required
核心义：呼吁
吸引力、感染力陷阱义
The story has a wide appeal, which explains why it was adapted for television.
这个故事极有吸引力，这解释了它为什么被改编成电视剧。
搭配 · have appeal for sb / have appeal with sb / wide appeal / immediate appeal
吸引（某人）；让人产生兴趣陷阱义
Bright colours and simple designs appeal strongly to young children in the city.
鲜艳的颜色和简洁的设计对城市里的幼儿很有吸引力。
搭配 · appeal to sb / appeal to the taste of / appeal strongly to
上诉、申诉陷阱义
He appealed to the court, claiming that the decision had been unfair.
他向法院提起上诉，声称裁决不公。
搭配 · appeal to the court / appeal against a decision / lodge an appeal / appeal against a verdict
assumption/əˈsʌmpʃn/required
核心义：假定
承担、接管（责任、权力、职位）陷阱义
Her assumption of responsibility for the project changed the way the whole team worked.
她承担起这个项目的责任，改变了整个团队的做事方式。
搭配 · assumption of responsibility / assumption of power / assumption of office
在…的前提下（固定搭配）陷阱义
He signed the form on the assumption that the company would pay for the training.
他是在「公司会承担培训费用」这一前提下签了那张表。
搭配 · on the assumption that / on this assumption / under the assumption that
假定、假设（未加证实的前提）
The plan was built on the assumption that volunteers would stay for the whole summer.
这个计划建立在志愿者会整个夏天都留下来这一假定之上。
搭配 · make an assumption / a reasonable assumption / the basic assumption / an unwarranted assumption
attempt/əˈtempt/required
核心义：尝试
尝试、努力
He made an attempt to break the school record.
他尝试打破学校纪录。
搭配 · make an attempt / attempt to do
average/ˈævərɪdʒ/required
核心义：平均的
平均的；普通的；平均数
On average, students here read eight books a term.
平均而言，这里的学生一学期读八本书。
搭配 · on average / an average of
bear/beə/required
核心义：熊；忍受
承受、忍受（痛苦、压力、后果）陷阱义
She bore the pain of the serious injury without ever complaining to anyone.
她默默忍受着严重伤痛的折磨，从未向任何人抱怨。
搭配 · bear the pain / bear the consequences / bear the pressure / bear with me
承担（责任、义务）陷阱义
Every citizen should bear part of the responsibility for protecting the environment.
每位公民都应承担保护环境的部分责任。
搭配 · bear the responsibility / bear responsibility for / bear the duty / bear part of the cost
生育、产下（孩子）陷阱义
The young couple are expecting their first child and will bear a daughter next spring.
这对年轻夫妇正期待第一个孩子的到来，明年春天将迎来一个女儿。
搭配 · bear a child / bear a son / bear children / give birth to
benefit/ˈbenɪfɪt/required
核心义：好处
益处；受益
Students benefit greatly from reading widely.
学生从广泛阅读中获益良多。
搭配 · benefit from / for the benefit of
capacity/kəˈpæsəti/required
核心义：容量
产能、生产能力（系统可产出的规模）陷阱义
The company is expanding its production capacity so that it can meet the rising demand of overseas buyers.
公司正在扩大生产能力，以便满足海外买家不断增长的需求。
搭配 · production capacity / expand capacity / idle capacity / capacity building
能力、才能（做某事的本领）陷阱义
Reading widely gives young people the capacity to think about problems in a wider context.
广泛阅读使年轻人有能力在更宏观的背景下思考问题。
搭配 · the capacity to do sth / have the capacity for / human capacity / a capacity for learning
以…的身份、资格（充当…的身份）陷阱义
He accepted the invitation to speak in the capacity of the school's headmaster.
他以校长的身份接受了演讲邀请。
搭配 · in the capacity of / in his capacity as / in an official capacity
care/kɛr/required
核心义：关心；照顾
关心、照顾；在意
Who will take care of the cat while we are away?
我们不在时谁来照顾这只猫？
搭配 · take care of / care about
case/keɪs/required
核心义：案例；病例
案件；诉讼案陷阱义
The police are still looking for clues after the case was closed last month.
该案上月结案后，警方仍在寻找线索。
搭配 · a murder case / close a case / the case against sb / case history
例子；典型案例陷阱义
This case is often cited to show how quickly information spreads online.
这个案例常被用来说明信息在网上传播得有多快。
搭配 · a case in point / a case study / a typical case / cite a case
病例；病人个案陷阱义
Doctors said the case was unusual, and that it required careful treatment in hospital.
医生说这个病例不寻常，需要在医院里精心治疗。
搭配 · a case of flu / a severe case of / a confirmed case / treat the case
cause/kɔz/required
核心义：原因
原因；事业；导致
Doctors are still looking for the cause of the disease.
医生仍在寻找这种疾病的起因。
搭配 · the cause of / cause sb to do
challenge/ˈtʃæləndʒ/required
核心义：挑战
（对既有认知的）质疑、挑战陷阱义
Her findings pose a challenge to widely accepted ideas in the field.
她的发现对这一领域中被广泛接受的观念构成了挑战。
搭配 · pose a challenge to / a challenge to traditional thinking / represent a challenge
质疑、反驳（对某个说法提出疑问）陷阱义
Several researchers challenged the old assumption that talent alone finally decides a person's success.
几位研究者质疑了「仅凭天赋就能决定一个人的成功」这一假设。
搭配 · challenge the view that / challenge sb's claim / challenge an assumption / be challenged by
向…发起挑战、要求对方做陷阱义
The young team challenged their rivals to a friendly match on the last day.
这支年轻队在最后一天向对手发起了一场友谊赛的挑战。
搭配 · challenge sb to a duel / challenge sb to do sth / challenge sb to a match
characteristic/ˌkærəktəˈrɪstɪk/required
核心义：特征
品质、素养（人的优良素质）陷阱义
Patience is the quality that this young teacher has shown again and again in class.
耐心是这位年轻老师在课堂上一次次展现出的品质。
搭配 · fine characteristics / a noble characteristic / characteristics of a leader
典型的、特有的（是…的典型特征）陷阱义
It is characteristic of this old town that every street follows the shape of the river.
这座古镇的特点是每一条街道都顺着河流的走向延伸。
搭配 · be characteristic of / a characteristic style / characteristic of the period
特征、特点、性质
One important characteristic of the language is that it has no written form at all.
这种语言的一个重要特征是它根本没有书面形式。
搭配 · a key characteristic / the characteristics of / an obvious characteristic / distinctive characteristics
charge/tʃɑ:dʒ/required
核心义：收费
控告、以某罪名指控（某人）陷阱义
He was charged with cheating, but he was later cleared of all blame.
他被指控作弊，但后来洗清了所有嫌疑。
搭配 · be charged with / charge sb with sth / face a charge / be charged with fraud
承担、负责（某项任务）陷阱义
Each team was charged with solving a problem that had puzzled engineers for years.
每个小组都承担了一项困扰工程师多年的难题。
搭配 · be charged with a task / be charged with doing sth / charge oneself with
猛冲；扑上去陷阱义
The bull charged at the fence as the crowd stepped back in alarm.
人群惊叫着后退时，那头公牛猛地朝栅栏冲了过来。
搭配 · charge at sb / charge into / charge down / charge the goal
concern/kənˈsɜ:n/required
核心义：关心
涉及、关系到（与某事有关）陷阱义
As far as the local economy is concerned, the new policy has brought few benefits.
就当地经济而言，这项新政策带来的好处很少。
搭配 · as far as sb is concerned / concerning / be concerned with / concern oneself with
关切之事、值得关注的问题陷阱义
Safety on the road has become a growing concern for families with young children.
道路安全已日益成为家有幼儿的家庭关注的问题。
搭配 · a growing concern / a major concern / a public concern / of great concern
忧虑、担心的情绪
She looked at the old photograph with obvious concern, as if she had lost something precious.
她带着明显的忧虑看着那张旧照片，仿佛失去了什么珍贵的东西。
搭配 · with concern / out of concern for / show concern / deep concern
conduct/kənˈdʌkt/required
核心义：行为（名词）
进行、实施（调查与实验）陷阱义
The research team conducted a survey among students from different schools last term.
该研究团队上学期在来自不同学校的学生中开展了一项调查。
搭配 · conduct a survey / conduct research / conduct an experiment / conduct an interview
组织、筹办（活动与比赛）陷阱义
The school will conduct a sports meeting next month, to which all students are welcome.
学校将于下月举办运动会，欢迎所有学生参加。
搭配 · conduct a meeting / conduct a ceremony / conduct a competition
指挥、带领（乐队或队伍）陷阱义
She conducted the orchestra without a score, surprising everyone in the hall.
她不看谱指挥了整支乐团，让全场的人都吃了一惊。
搭配 · conduct an orchestra / conduct a choir / conduct a team
consequence/ˈkɒnsɪkwəns/required
核心义：结果
重要性、紧要性陷阱义
Whether the meeting goes ahead is of little consequence to the rest of the plan.
会议是否照常举行，对计划的其他部分无关紧要。
搭配 · of little consequence / of no consequence / of great consequence / of much consequence
因此、所以（in consequence）陷阱义
The road was blocked for repairs; in consequence, several classes were delayed that afternoon.
道路因维修被封锁，因此那天下午有几节课推迟了。
搭配 · in consequence / in consequence of / as a consequence
结果、结局（某种行为带来的）
Few people can predict all the consequences of such a sudden change in daily routine.
很少有人能预想到日常作息如此突变会带来的所有后果。
搭配 · the consequences of doing sth / serious consequences / a consequence of / unintended consequences
content/'kɒntent/required
核心义：内容
含量、成分比例（食品）陷阱义
Food with a high sugar content should not be given to small children too often.
含糖量高的食物不应经常给幼儿食用。
搭配 · high fat content / low sugar content / the content of the soil
满足的、知足的（be content with）陷阱义
He seemed content with the simple life he had chosen for himself.
他似乎对自己选择的简朴生活感到满足。
搭配 · be content with / be content to do / content oneself with
目录（书刊的篇目清单）陷阱义
You can find the topic of each chapter in the contents at the back of the book.
你可以在书后的目录中找到每一章的话题。
搭配 · table of contents / the contents of a book / contents page
contrast/ˈkɒntrɑ:st/required
核心义：对比
把…进行对比（A 与 B）陷阱义
The author contrasts life in the city with that in small villages.
作者把城市生活与小村庄的生活作了对比。
搭配 · contrast A with B / contrast with / contrast the two versions
与…截然不同、形成反差陷阱义
The final result contrasts sharply with what most of the people had expected.
最终结果与大多数人的预期形成鲜明反差。
搭配 · contrast sharply with / contrast with expectations / stand in contrast to
（by contrast）相比之下陷阱义
By contrast, small towns often provide better chances for children to grow up happily.
相比之下，小城镇往往能为孩子提供更好的成长环境。
搭配 · by contrast / in contrast to / in contrast with / by contrast with
count/kaʊnt/required
核心义：计算；数数
数数；把…算入；重要、有价值
You can count on me when you need help.
你需要帮助时可以指望我。
搭配 · count on / count as
cover/ˈkʌvə/required
核心义：覆盖
报道、采访（新闻、赛事）陷阱义
Journalists from several countries covered the climate summit in great detail for weeks.
来自几个国家的记者详细报道了这次气候峰会。
搭配 · cover the summit / cover the story / be widely covered / cover the event
支付、承担（费用）陷阱义
The scholarship covers tuition fees but not the living expenses of students.
该奖学金涵盖学费，但不包括学生的生活费。
搭配 · cover the cost / cover expenses / be covered by insurance / cover the fee
封面、封底（书刊杂志的一页）陷阱义
Her photograph appeared on the front cover of a well-known travel magazine.
她的照片出现在一本畅销旅游杂志的封面上。
搭配 · on the cover of / the front cover / a magazine cover / cover story
crisis/ˈkraɪsɪs/required
核心义：危机
危机、紧要关头
The company is in crisis after losing its main customer.
失去主要客户后，公司陷入危机。
搭配 · in crisis / a financial crisis
critical/ˈkrɪtɪkl/required
核心义：批判的
至关重要的、决定性的（be critical to）陷阱义
Clean water is critical to the health of every community in the region.
清洁的水对该地区每个社区的健康都至关重要。
搭配 · be critical to / be critical for / a critical part / play a critical role
危急的、危重的（critical condition）陷阱义
The injured man was still in a critical condition when the ambulance arrived.
救护车赶到时，那名伤者仍处于危重状态。
搭配 · in a critical condition / a critical stage / a critical moment / critically ill
评论界的；评论性的（critical acclaim）陷阱义
The documentary received critical acclaim for its honest look at rural life.
这部纪录片因其对乡村生活的坦率呈现而受到评论界好评。
搭配 · critical acclaim / critical response / critical reviews / critical response from critics
current/ˈkʌrənt/required
核心义：当前的
时事、时政（current affairs）陷阱义
Students who keep up with current affairs are often better able to form their own views.
经常关注时事的学生往往更能形成自己的看法。
搭配 · current affairs / world affairs / keep up with current affairs
水流、洋流（有方向的水流）陷阱义
Warm currents carry heat away from the equator and towards the northern seas every year.
暖流每年都把热量从赤道带往北部海域。
搭配 · a warm current / ocean currents / the current is strong / against the current
电流（电学中的电流）陷阱义
The device draws a small current from the battery to power its screen.
这个装置从电池中抽取很小的电流来驱动屏幕。
搭配 · electric current / direct current / a strong current / current flows through
damage/ˈdæmɪdʒ/required
核心义：损害
损害、破坏；损失
Smoking does serious damage to your lungs.
吸烟严重损害你的肺。
搭配 · do damage to / damage the environment
demand/dɪˈmɑ:nd/required
核心义：要求
需求；要求、强烈要求
Skilled workers are in demand in this city.
这个城市需要熟练工人。
搭配 · in demand / demand that
develop/dɪˈveləp/required
核心义：生长；开发（资源）
养成、发展出（习惯、兴趣）陷阱义
She developed a habit of reading before bed during her first year at university.
她在上大学第一年养成了睡前阅读的习惯。
搭配 · develop a habit of / develop an interest in / develop a reputation / develop skills
患上、染上（疾病）陷阱义
He developed a bad cold after walking home in the rain that evening.
那天晚上冒雨走回家后，他患了重感冒。
搭配 · develop a cold / develop a disease / develop symptoms / develop cancer
冲洗（胶片、照片）陷阱义
He developed the film at home before showing the pictures to the class.
他在把照片给全班看之前，先在家里把胶片冲洗了出来。
搭配 · develop film / develop a photograph / develop the negatives
display/dɪˈspleɪ/required
核心义：展示
展示、陈列；显示
The old photos are on display in the hall.
老照片在大厅里展出。
搭配 · on display / display a sign
draw/drɔ/required
核心义：画；拉
画；拉；吸引；推断出
The loud noise drew everyone’s attention.
巨大的响声吸引了所有人的注意。
搭配 · draw attention / draw a conclusion
drive/draɪv/required
核心义：驾驶
驾驶；推动；动力
The noise from next door is driving me mad.
隔壁的噪音快把我逼疯了。
搭配 · drive a car / drive sb mad
drop/drɔp/required
核心义：掉落
落下；减少；放弃；滴
He dropped out of school to support his family.
他辍学去养家。
搭配 · drop out / a drop in
effect/ɪˈfekt/required
核心义：影响
效果、效力（药效、法律效力）陷阱义
The medicine had a quick effect on her headache and she slept well that night.
这种药对她的头痛很快就见效了，那晚她睡得很好。
搭配 · take effect / come into effect / bring into effect / the effect of the drug
副作用（side effects）陷阱义
Long-term use of the device may bring side effects that are hard to ignore.
长期使用这种设备可能带来难以忽视的副作用。
搭配 · side effects / adverse effects / have no side effects / serious side effects
实现、促成（变革）陷阱义
The committee hopes to effect a real change in the way the team works.
委员会希望促成团队工作方式的真正改变。
搭配 · effect a change / effect reforms / effect improvement / to effect change
emphasis/ˈemfəsɪs/required
核心义：强调
重点、侧重之处陷阱义
In the new design, the emphasis has shifted from decoration to practical use.
在新设计中，重点已从装饰转向实用。
搭配 · a shift in emphasis / the emphasis of the study / a different emphasis
重音、重读（词的发音着力点）陷阱义
The emphasis in the word falls on the last syllable, which slightly changes its meaning.
这个单词的重音落在最后一个音节上，这略微改变了它的意思。
搭配 · the emphasis falls on / stress and emphasis / word emphasis
强调、着重（把注意力集中在…）
The school places great emphasis on reading aloud every morning before the first class begins.
